name: rr-policy-guards
description: Pre-tool-use policy hooks for the Rational Reserve platform: rr-emoji-guard (pure-ASCII file writes), rr-bash-guard (no bare $VAR expansion), rr-brew-guard (supply-chain-risky brew flags/URL installs/untrusted taps), rr-tofu-guard (no direct tofu apply/destroy/import from a Bash tool use). Each guard audit-logs to ~/.rational-reserve/logs/ and supports a per-guard RR_*_GUARD_BYPASS=1 env var.
